name: Video Thumbnail Post-Processing Diagnostics
changes: Adds browser-side Video thumbnail post-processing failure classification so passive diagnostics can distinguish browser decode failure, no-frame samples, frame timeouts, capture failures, FFmpeg-required formats, and thumbnail-store failures.
Preserves visible/prefetch demand and partial/complete sample context in aggregate Video post-processing telemetry without recording media contents.
Browsing-performance schema 8 now retains reason-specific timing and counters for video_thumbnail_post while leaving the existing Image reason pipeline unchanged.

Preserves the accepted six-slot Video ceiling, five-request Image HTTP gate, 24 MB/12-segment Video sample bounds, 800/800/1000 headers, All Posts accumulator, settings-save retry behavior, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Video scheduling, connection allocation, sample-size/segment limits, and browser frame timeout remain unchanged; v3.6.70 adds classification only.
video_thumbnail_post reason telemetry is retained server-side with demand and sample completeness context, and failure counters remain aggregate/passive.
Image admission stays 5, high-connection Video ceiling stays 6, browsing headers stay 800/800/1000, and All Posts render accumulator constants remain unchanged.
Settings save retry remains limited to WinError 5/32/33 for 3 seconds; SABnzbd remains 5.1.2 and terminal-history schema remains 3.
